out.title: Zee allots 209.4 million convertible warrants to promoter Sunbright Mauritius
out.summary: Zee allotted 20,94,47,805 fully convertible warrants at ₹126 each to promoter group entity Sunbright Mauritius Investments on August 21, 2026, receiving 25% (₹659.76 crore); conversion within 18 months gives ~17.9% stake.
